Abstract.AbstractText: Nutritional treatment of intensive care patients may require an accurate, effective and personalized approach in the future. Using nutritional risk assessment to guide nutritional treatment, factors including timing, energy expenditure and goal, pathway and dosage should be considered. Through testing the individual nutritional molecular markers, the benefits and risks can be evaluated. So nutritional therapy can enhance the nutritional and metabolic status of intensive care patients, and improve clinical outcomes.
